structured_output.summary: Fixed the finding: apply_range now returns early unless the status is 200, so a 304 from apply_conditions is no longer turned into a 206. Added test_apply_range_skipped_after_304, which runs apply_conditions then apply_range on the same request. Nothing was run, since I had no command access.
